title.zh: 二项分布到正态 · 钉板上长出的钟形
title.en: Binomial to Normal · The Bell Curve Growing on a Pegboard

desc.zh: 小球在钉板上一层层向左或向右，落点的柱状图随层数增加，越来越像那口钟。
desc.en: A ball goes left or right at every peg; as the rows increase, the histogram of landing bins looks more and more like the bell.
